title: User-selectable primary sort axis (RAM/disk-first mode)
description: Let RAM- or storage-heavy buyers (NAS, in-memory cache workloads) promote price_per_gb_ram or price_per_tb_disk to the primary sort instead of price_per_benchmark_point_multi. Direct extension of ADR-3's 'separate metrics, user decides priority' philosophy -- benchmark-value stays the documented default, this is opt-in. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #2. v1.1 tier.

title: Saved/named filter presets (URL-encoded)
description: Serialize current filter state into URL query params on every filter change, read back on page load -- bookmarkable, no sharing required, pure self-bookmarking for the one real user. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #5. v1.1 tier -- user explicitly deprioritized this behind core v1 functionality, hence Low priority.

title: Diff view between two Parquet snapshots
description: Client-side (IndexedDB) comparison of 'what changed since I last looked' -- cache the previous fetched snapshot and diff row-by-config-signature against the current one. Gets partial price-history value weeks before v2's full historical-stats architecture ships, with zero pipeline changes. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #3. v1.1 tier.

title: Cross-link listings to Hetzner's own Cloud catalog pricing
description: Show 'X% cheaper than the equivalent still-selling Hetzner Cloud instance' on each listing. Requires a small, separately hand-maintained lookup table mapping common CPU/RAM/disk tiers to their nearest Hetzner Cloud SKU price (catalog pricing changes rarely, unlike the 10-min auction feed, so maintenance burden is low). From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #4. v1.1 tier -- note in Components as a small new lookup artifact, distinct from benchmark-map/.

title: Starter-configs + one-click best-deal button
description: Pre-built example searches (e.g. Budget web server, Home NAS, Game server) as one-click filter presets, plus a single 'best deal now' button returning one defensible top-value listing (highest price_per_benchmark_point_multi, benchmark_matched=true). For a first-time visitor who doesn't want to configure filters at all. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, docs/notes/ideas-ledger.md finalist #1. v1.1 tier — not blocking Phase 5's core filter/sort scope.
